newsitem.title: USA: Reynolds buys 2 healthcare systems vendors.
newsitem.headline: Reynolds buys 2 healthcare systems vendors.

text.p: Reynolds and Reynolds Co said Monday it has signed agreements to buy the assets of Fiscal Information Inc of Daytona Beach, Florida, and the stock of Fiscal Information Inc of Loveland, Colorado.
Both companies are systems vendors to physician practices.
Terms were not disclosed, but Reynolds and Reynolds said the companies reported combined 1996 sales of about $10 million.
"These acquisitions are consistent with our plans to aggressively grow our position in the healthcare systems marketplace," said David R. Holmes, Reynolds and Reynolds' chairman, president and CEO.
Reynolds and Reynolds, which supplies integrated information management systems, said the companies had impressive growth, high customer satisfaction and solid profitability.

"As we integrate the business with our own Healthcare Systems Division and leverage Reynolds' financial and systems strengths, we expect to continue to grow the base business and expand our company's healthcare systems presence throughout the country," the company said in a statement.
